metadata.no_hallucinations_commitment: Zero prices, gram weights, karats, hallmarks, or stone weights were estimated, interpolated, or copied from search snippets without opening the live official retailer product page on 2026-10-22. Whenever an official product page omits a value (such as gram weight on Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth, Mejuri, or Local Eclectic, static setting price in VRAI's JS configurator, or hallmark stamps across online listings) or contradicts itself (such as Blue Nile Stock 501290y or Local Eclectic Simple Knot Ring), the field is left blank (null) and flagged as unverified.

rings.pricing_scope: Complete Ring (Plated Vermeil — NOT Solid Gold)

rings.return_window_summary: 30-day free returns
irregularity_flags: DISQUALIFIED BY CHECKLIST CHK-02 (Not Solid Gold): Included as an anti-hallucination / keyword-trap control case because the page text contains the substring '18k solid gold' inside 'a thick layer of 18k solid gold plated on 91% recycled sterling silver'. Base metal is 92.5% silver, not solid karat gold.

XRF testing alert (ISO 23345:2021): 2.5 µm 18K gold electroplate over Ag925 will show strong Ag K-alpha fluorescence and surface Au distortion on ED-XRF — demonstrating why XRF immediately catches vermeil misrepresented as solid gold.
